Our next chapter

Our vision extends
beyond producing lithium.

We believe Northeast Texas has the potential to become a center for critical-mineral production, processing and advanced manufacturing—creating investment, skilled jobs and economic opportunity while strengthening America’s critical-minerals supply chain.

Production is the foundation. The larger opportunity is attracting the technology, people and industries that can build around it.

Lithium beneath Northeast Texas

A new opportunity from a familiar resource.

Thousands of feet underground, Smackover formation brines contain naturally occurring lithium. Bright Star is applying energy-industry expertise to evaluate and develop these deep subsurface resources.

Our development concepts use wells and selective extraction, with processed brine designed to return to the subsurface.

Conceptual process flowTwo separate streams
01 / 04

Produce lithium-rich brine

Wells would bring lithium-bearing formation brine to the surface. Reservoir analysis informs well placement, rates and the development concept.

Final process, injection interval and configuration remain subject to engineering, reservoir modeling and permitting. Water, reagents and other process streams are omitted.

A different kind of lithium development

Subsurface resource.
Smaller surface footprint.

Our concepts use wells rather than a conventional open-pit mine. This approach has the potential to reduce surface disturbance while drawing on energy-industry technologies and operating practices.

Land, water and community protection remain design priorities. Actual impacts depend on the final wells, pipelines, facilities and operating requirements.

Our projects · Northeast Texas

From resource
to production.

We bring geology, wells, extraction, processing, infrastructure and reinjection into development concepts designed specifically for Northeast Texas.

Our development pathway is shown below. It does not indicate that each stage has been reached.

  1. 01

    Discover

    Understand what lies beneath.

    Use subsurface data, drilling, sampling and reservoir analysis to identify and evaluate lithium-rich brines.

  2. 02

    Prove

    Define the opportunity.

    Characterize brine chemistry, productive capacity and resource potential to evaluate commercial development.

  3. 03

    Develop

    Engineer responsible solutions.

    Integrate wells, DLE, processing and infrastructure with a technically appropriate reinjection design.

  4. 04

    Produce

    Produce lithium in Texas.

    Establish reliable, long-term production of lithium products from Northeast Texas resources.

  5. 05

    Grow

    Build around the resource.

    Attract downstream processing and advanced manufacturing closer to the lithium supply.

Build at the source

What if the supply chain started here?

Reliable lithium production in Northeast Texas could become the foundation for investment in processing, battery materials, advanced manufacturing and supporting industries.

A shorter supply chain has the potential to reduce transportation and logistics costs, improve supply security and retain more economic value in the United States.

Our communities

Local first.

Bright Star is part of Northeast Texas. Strong relationships with landowners, local businesses, schools, elected officials and regional organizations are essential to the future we are working to build.

We don’t simply want to produce lithium in Northeast Texas.
We want Northeast Texas to benefit from producing it.

As projects advance, our goals include:

01

Skilled employment

Opportunities in technical, operational, construction, engineering and manufacturing careers.

02

Local business

Working with regional contractors, suppliers and service companies whenever practical.

03

Investment

Attracting long-term private capital and infrastructure investment to Northeast Texas.

04

Education & workforce

Supporting the technical workforce needed for a new critical-minerals industry.

05

Long-term economic development

Using the resource as a foundation for additional processing, manufacturing and supporting industries.

From Texas to the world—and back to Texas

Partner globally.
Manufacture locally.

Bright Star and Galvanic Energy envision partnerships connecting Northeast Texas lithium with proven technology and manufacturing expertise in trusted allied nations.

The longer-term objective is to create a compelling economic reason for partners to invest in processing and manufacturing here in Texas.

An initial pathway

Connect with established global capabilities.

Future Texas-produced lithium may initially supply established manufacturing facilities outside the United States.

BSL

Powered by Galvanic Energy

Proven resource expertise.
A new Texas opportunity.

Bright Star Lithium is the Northeast Texas lithium development affiliate of Galvanic Energy, a U.S. critical-minerals company experienced in identifying, acquiring, evaluating and advancing lithium-brine resources.

Galvanic applied its resource-first strategy to its initial Smackover lithium project before its divestiture in 2023. Bright Star represents the next chapter.

Meet Galvanic Energy ↗

Our mission

Develop Texas resources.
Create American opportunity.

Responsibly develop Northeast Texas lithium resources into reliable domestic production, creating a foundation for investment, advanced manufacturing, skilled jobs and stronger American critical-minerals supply chains.

Our vision

Make Northeast Texas a destination for industry.

A future where lithium does more than leave the region as a raw material—where processing, technology, manufacturing, infrastructure and people come here because of it.

Texas Resources. American Opportunity.

We’re working to transform a resource deep beneath Northeast Texas into an opportunity that reaches far beyond it.
